annotation_policy.source: Assistant visual review with model-generated initial hints; not organizer ground truth or a second human annotator.
annotation_policy.definition: Smallest visually supported rectangle covering the person, including visible limbs. Exclude furniture, bags and draped garments. Image-clipped people stop at the image boundary. Full-box targets require evidence for the outer body extrema, not visibility of every interior pixel.
annotation_policy.uncertainty: If table/neighbor hides an unknown outer body extent, record visible extent and pose only; leave all full-box coordinates NaN. Do not synthesize a hidden foot position or use neighboring GT as the target.
annotation_policy.selection: Frozen DINOv2 ViT-S/14 crop appearance diversity; at least 180s from previously annotated frames and 300s between selected frames on each day. Manual pose-redundancy exclusions applied afterward.
annotation_policy.geometry_training: Use only supported full boxes, preserve native camera scale, mask uncertain visible people, and reject an image when masking would remove >3% of any supported target. Never feed the sparse geometry CSV to a full-frame detector as exhaustive annotations.
annotation_policy.reviewed_model_hints: Existing same-day-only teacher; no opposite-day fitting in annotation proposal model.

control: No-new-label control has exactly the same number of exposures/optimizer steps as the augmented variant in each fold.
caveat: Exploratory comparison on two reused days; manually checked assistant annotations are not organizer ground truth. Additional hypotheses included small crop training and continuation from original-GT-only warm starts; neither passed the improvement gate.
